name: drizzle-graphql-plus
author: alcala.rao@gmail.com (Roy Alcala)
description: Automatically generate GraphQL schema or customizable schema config fields from Drizzle ORM schema

scripts.pack: rm -f *.tgz && (cd dist && npm pack --pack-destination ..) && mv drizzle-graphql-plus-*.tgz package.tgz
scripts.build:pack:publish: pnpm run test && pnpm build && (cd dist && npm pack --pack-destination ..) && mv drizzle-graphql-plus-*.tgz package.tgz && npm publish package.tgz --access public --no-provenance
scripts.test: pnpm test:dataloader && pnpm test:serial-hooks && pnpm test:export-hooks && pnpm test:export-integration-serial
scripts.test:dataloader: rm -f src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/test-resolvers.db && npx drizzle-kit push --dialect=sqlite --schema=./src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/schema.ts --url=file:src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/test-resolvers.db && vitest run src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/resolvers.test.ts
scripts.test:serial-hooks: rm -f src/serial-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-serial-hooks.db && npx drizzle-kit push --dialect=sqlite --schema=./src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/schema.ts --url=file:src/serial-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-serial-hooks.db && vitest run src/serial-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/serial-hooks.test.ts
scripts.test:export-hooks: rm -f src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-export-hooks.db && npx drizzle-kit push --dialect=sqlite --schema=./src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/schema.ts --url=file:src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-export-hooks.db && vitest run src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/export-hooks.test.ts
scripts.test:export-integration-serial: rm -f src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-export-integration.db && npx drizzle-kit push --dialect=sqlite --schema=./src/build-schema-sdl-with-dl/tests/schema.ts --url=file:src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/test-export-integration.db && vitest run src/export-directive-envelop-hooks/tests/export-integration-with-serial.test.ts
